params.prompt:
Bethlehem, a little hill town in ancient Israel, at dawn: the small town square outside the house of Jesse. Flat-roofed limestone and mudbrick houses with wooden doors, a vine-covered pergola, stone steps up to the rooftops, clay water jars, low stone walls, date palms and cypress trees behind the roofs; oil lanterns still glowing amber by the doors while the sky turns from deep blue to the first gold of sunrise.
The family of Jesse is starting the day. At the right, old Jesse, a grey-bearded father in a striped robe, stands in his doorway. His seven older sons, tall grown young men, are busy and self-important across the middle of the square: one polishing a sword, two arguing over bread, one stretching, one carrying a water jar, two laughing together. Nobody is looking at the youngest.
At the left, the youngest son, David, a small teenage shepherd boy with warm olive skin, curly dark hair, a simple cream tunic, a muted red sash and a leather sling in his belt, holds a wooden shepherd's staff and leads a little flock of sheep out of the square toward the open road and the hills, happily, a lamb at his heels. The camera will rise and follow him out to the fields.
Ancient Israel, no modern objects, no text.
STYLE (most important): a 2D hand-drawn illustration in exactly the style of the style reference image (the prophet anointing the kneeling young man): a frame from a hand-drawn epic animated feature film. Confident dark-brown ink outlines around every shape — buildings, stones, trees, pots, figures; simplified, stylised forms; cel-style shading with flat colour areas and soft painted gradients; visible gouache brush texture and a faint warm paper grain; stylised swirling clouds and graphic light rays; warm honey-gold and amber against deep lapis blue. It must clearly read as a drawing and a painting, NOT as a photograph or a 3D render: no photographic detail, no realistic textures, no depth-of-field blur, no lens effects.
Format: an ultra-wide letterboxed cinema frame. Solid pure-black bars fill the top 21% and the bottom 21% of the image edge to edge; the picture exists only in the 4:1 panoramic strip between them, and the whole subject, including its top and bottom edges, fits completely inside that strip with a little breathing room. Nothing crosses into the black bars.
